project.title: Launch Capsule Collection With Integrated Visual Identity
project.objective: Design a limited-run apparel capsule and cohesive visual identity for an online drop, aligned with brand guidelines and production constraints.
deliverables: Seasonal capsule collection concept and moodboard
Final garment designs with technical sketches and colorways
Digital 3D garment prototypes for key looks
Visual identity kit for the capsule (logo lockups, typography, palette)
Marketing asset pack for e-commerce and social media
constraints: Collection limited to 8–10 SKUs to fit sampling budget
All fabrics must be sourced from existing supplier list
Visual identity must align with current brand guidelines
First production-ready specs due within 21 days
3D prototypes required for at least 4 hero looks
All assets must be optimized for web and mobile use

risks.risk: Fabric availability issues delay finalizing color and material choices.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize materials from confirmed stock and define backup fabrics and colorways early.

risks.risk: Visual identity diverges from existing brand perception.
risks.mitigation: Run early brand alignment review and keep a shared guideline doc for quick checks.

risks.risk: 3D prototype iterations take longer than planned.
risks.mitigation: Limit 3D to hero looks, lock base patterns early, and reuse templates where possible.

risks.risk: Misalignment between design intent and production constraints.
risks.mitigation: Involve production manager in spec reviews and flag complex construction details early.

themes.why_relevant: Designers must stay creative while respecting fabric, cost, and manufacturing limits.
Team uses 3D tools and digital mockups to speed approvals and reduce sampling.

themes.theme: Brand consistency across fashion and graphics
themes.why_relevant: Garments and visual identity must feel like one coherent capsule under the brand.
Fashion and graphic designers need tight async feedback to hit the deadline.
Assets must be optimized for online launch, including imagery and layouts.

backlog.task: Define capsule collection concept, theme, and target customer profile
definition_of_done: Concept moodboard created and shared
Target customer profile documented
Theme and key storylines approved in channel
Constraints from production and marketing acknowledged

backlog.task: Create initial garment sketches and silhouettes for 10–12 options
definition_of_done: At least 10 rough sketches uploaded
Silhouettes tagged by category and fabric intent
Team feedback collected and 8–10 options shortlisted

backlog.task: Develop detailed technical drawings and specs for selected SKUs
definition_of_done: Flat technical drawings completed for each selected SKU
Measurements, construction notes, and trims documented
Specs reviewed with production constraints checklist

backlog.task: Build 3D garment prototypes for 4 hero looks
definition_of_done: 3D models created for 4 hero looks
3D fits reviewed against standard sizing systems
Screenshots and short turntable clips shared for feedback

backlog.task: Define capsule visual identity (logo lockup, palette, typography)
definition_of_done: 3 visual identity directions proposed
One direction selected after feedback
Final logo lockups, palette, and type styles documented

backlog.task: Design garment prints, labels, and packaging graphics
definition_of_done: Prints and label layouts created for all SKUs needing them
Packaging mockups aligned with capsule identity
Print-ready files exported in required formats

backlog.task: Produce e-commerce product image guidelines and layout templates
definition_of_done: Image style guide drafted and shared
Templates for product detail pages and banners created
Guidelines approved by marketing stakeholder

backlog.task: Consolidate production-ready spec pack for manufacturers
definition_of_done: All tech packs compiled into a single folder
Fabric and trim references cross-checked
Spec pack shared with production manager for sign-off

backlog.task: Create social media teaser and launch asset concepts
definition_of_done: Storyboard or layout concepts for teaser posts created
Static and motion-friendly formats considered
Shortlist of concepts agreed with marketing

backlog.task: Run design review for fit, comfort, and wearability
definition_of_done: 3D and 2D designs reviewed for fit and movement
Potential comfort issues documented
Adjustments captured as version updates in specs

backlog.task: Align on final colorways and fabric combinations
definition_of_done: Color palette applied to all SKUs
Fabric choices validated against supplier list
Final color/fabric matrix shared and approved

backlog.task: Prepare final capsule overview deck for internal launch
definition_of_done: Deck includes concept, looks, identity, and timelines
Key visuals and 3D renders embedded
Deck shared in channel before deadline

artifacts.title: Capsule Concept and Moodboard
artifacts.used_for: Captures theme, references, and target customer to align all design decisions.

artifacts.title: SKU and Colorway Matrix
artifacts.used_for: Tracks SKUs, fabrics, colors, and status across the capsule.

artifacts.title: Capsule Visual Identity Guidelines
artifacts.used_for: Defines logo usage, palette, typography, and layout rules for the capsule.

artifacts.title: Production-Ready Spec Pack Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures each garment spec includes all required technical details.

artifacts.title: 3D Hero Look Preview Folder
artifacts.used_for: Central folder with 3D renders and clips for hero looks used in reviews.

artifacts.title: E-commerce Image and Layout Style Guide
artifacts.used_for: Specifies framing, lighting, and layout for product and campaign images.

artifacts.title: Social Launch Asset Plan
artifacts.used_for: Outlines required social formats, messaging angles, and timelines.

artifacts.title: Internal Capsule Overview Deck
artifacts.used_for: Summarizes concept, designs, and launch plan for internal stakeholders.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock capsule concept, theme, and target customer before detailed design.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message sharing early ideas and linking the initial moodboard draft.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select final capsule theme and narrative direction.
Agree on target customer profile and price positioning.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and refine garment sketches, silhouettes, and hero looks.
threads_plan.trigger: Fashion designer posts first batch of sketches and silhouette options.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the 8–10 SKUs to move into detailed specs.
Choose 4 hero looks for 3D prototyping and marketing focus.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on visual identity, logo lockups, and graphic direction.
threads_plan.trigger: Graphic designer shares 2–3 visual identity routes for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select one visual identity direction for the capsule.
Approve logo lockup and core color palette.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize production specs, colorways, and fabric choices.
threads_plan.trigger: Fashion designer posts draft spec pack and color/fabric matrix.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve final colorways and fabric combinations per SKU.
Sign off on production-ready spec pack for handoff.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on e-commerce and social launch assets and timelines.
threads_plan.trigger: Graphic designer shares draft e-commerce layouts and social teaser concepts.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm e-commerce image style and layout templates.
Lock social teaser concepts and posting sequence.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with top 3 priorities and blockers.
Twice-weekly design review thread for posting WIP sketches and layouts.
End-of-week recap summarizing decisions, updated risks, and next steps.
Pre-deadline go/no-go checklist review for specs and launch assets.
